snippet.title: Forgotten Hill: Puppeteer - Teaser
snippet.description:
New mysteries around Forgotten Hill. 
He's Coming soon... Can you survive?

Play Forgotten Hill: Puppetter
http://www.forgotten-hill.com/game/forgotten-hill-puppeteer/

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.fmstudio.forgottenhillpuppeteer
Amazon App Store: http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B01HBSNETM

Soundtrack: "Dark Walk"
